name: Base One 25 Rate
definition: Rate expressed as a decimal, for example, 0.7 is 7/10 and 70% with 13 fractional digits maximum and 25 total digits. May contain values larger than 1.
format: Required format is digits with an optional decimal point, for example 1500.25, at most 25 digits in total, of which at most 13 after the decimal point
